newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat against dollar.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat against the dollar at 472.00/473.25 in a session markedly quieter than Thursday's when the unit soared as dollar inflows to the Caracas bolsa tightened bolivar supplies, traders said.
"It was a well balanced market," said one trader.
The bolivar firmed in the morning to 471.10/472.10, but "that was reversed in the afternoon as banks sold bolivars to cover short dollar positions," said one trader.
Brokers said the Central Bank continued to monitor the market, but had not intervened.
